title: Department, notice of hearing.
bodyText: In establishing and prescribing the standards, or any alterations or modifications to the standards, the department of agriculture and biosecurity shall call a public hearing and give notice thereof in conformity with chapter 91.
bodyHtml: §147-55  Department, notice of hearing.  In establishing and prescribing the standards, or any alterations or modifications to the standards, the department of agriculture and biosecurity shall call a public hearing and give notice thereof in conformity with chapter 91. [L 1947, c 195, §5; RL 1955, §22-44; am L Sp 1959 2d, c 1, §22; am L 1961, c 132, §2; am L 1965, c 96, §20; HRS §147-55; am L 2025, c 236, §17]
